intent_en: Compare the active periods of five US-Russia nuclear treaties using their start and end years.
narration_support: Long-standing nuclear arms treaties are being reassessed
chart_support: Timeline chart showing the duration of US-Russia nuclear treaties (Anti-Ballistic Missile Treaty, INF, START I, SORT, New Start) from 1970 to 2021, with annotations indicating the US withdrawal from the INF treaty in 2018 and the expiration of New Start in 2021
evidence_note: The narration introduces the theme of reassessing nuclear treaties and new arms races. The chart supports this by visualizing the history of US-Russia treaties, specifically highlighting the end of the INF treaty (via US withdrawal) and the impending expiration of the New Start treaty, which validates the narration's claim about the current state of arms control.
narrative_goal: To illustrate the timeline and expiration of key US-Russia nuclear treaties, providing context for the reassessment of arms control and the potential for new arms races.
current_model_input: Compare the active periods of five US-Russia nuclear treaties using their start and end years.
